Offline OCR for Layout Sim (image paste). Bundled by `tools/build_layout_sim.py` into `layout-sim/ocr-engine.js`.
- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
- tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0), WebAssembly embedded
- eng.traineddata.gz: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int (tessdata, Apache-2.0)
